description: Dual-timeline chapter gate card that mentions a switch but omits body, elapsed-time, and care continuity.

input.chapter_goal: The investigator must use a sleep trigger to return to the historical body before the sealed record is moved.
input.main_event: She wakes in the historical body beside the sealed folder and opens the witness flap before the guard arrives.
input.worsening: If she waits, the folder leaves the archive; if she speaks, the sleeping modern body becomes suspicious to the monitor.
input.reader_mainline: A body switch can save the record but creates a second unattended body risk.
input.physical_operability: The record is folded inside a sealed folder; the visible line appears only after the second flap is opened under the desk lamp at the archive table.
input.next_pursuit: Who moved the historical body while the modern body was asleep?
